image_location_description: Middle of figure (chest/upper body); large white rectangular torso with subtle dark V-neck lines.

steps.title: Base footprint
steps.description: Place 1x White 3020 plate (2x4) as the torso base.

steps.title: Build core layer 1
steps.description: Add 4x White 3004 bricks (1x2) to form a 4x2 rectangle.

steps.title: Build core layer 2
steps.description: Stack 4x White 3004 bricks (1x2) directly above layer 1.

steps.title: Cap the torso
steps.description: Top with 1x White 3020 plate (2x4) to lock the block.

steps.title: Add V-neck hints
steps.description: Place 2x DBG 3024 plates (1x1) near top front to suggest a V.
